speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are in it today, I take it. You have the look of a man who means to be heard at two.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The comedy, at the Theatre. I am home after. Lay a supper, not a dinner.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is it the one with the oaths, sir? Mistress says they break them by dinner, and that she believes.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I said that once. I do not need it played back at me on a Monday. Eat.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The close was quiet when I went to the loom. I tell you only that. Quiet is not a promise.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Quiet is enough for a morning. The loaf is the same loaf as yesterday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Shrunk on the pan, and a penny, and still not a text. Go when you must. Do not bring the yard home with you.
